meta.generator: MAP Airtable CSV to MAP JSON Python Script

properties.Description: Schema containing MAP's Dance descriptors, affordance contracts, and loader dance response contract.
Meta-type describing dance-type descriptor holons and their descriptor-local input, response, and descriptive metadata.
Meta-type describing dance-response-type descriptor holons and their optional structured response-body type metadata.
Abstract holon type for descriptors of executable dances, linking to an optional request-contract holon type and a response holon type.
Abstract holon type for successful response holons returned from dances. Response bodies and diagnostics are ordinary holons.
Deprecated old-world abstract holon type for structured response bodies returned from dances. New-world response bodies are ordinary concrete holon types.
Message-only holon summarizing the outcome of a holon load operation (not persisted by the loader commit).
Concrete standalone dance type for the holon data loader.
properties.DanceDescription: Loads a transient HolonLoadSet, stages and commits valid imported holons, and returns a transient HolonLoadResponse.

properties.Description: Concrete holon type for invocation records capturing the dance invoked, the holon affording the dance, the request holon, and ingress context. The related holon is the subject affording the dance, not merely a target object.
Concrete binding of a DanceType with executable details (engine, module, entrypoint, ABI, version/compat).
Concrete holon type for non-fatal diagnostic notes attached to successful dance responses.
Abstract base type for value-shaped property-map holons used as request, parameter, response-body, or projected-result shapes.
Declared relationship from a HolonLoadResponse to one or more HolonError holons.
Inverse of HasLoadError. Points from HolonError back to the response that reported it.
Declares that a DanceType is afforded by a HolonType.
Inverse of DanceAffordedBy, exposing Dances afforded by a HolonType.
Binds a TypeDescriptor to a specific DanceImplementation that can be dispatched.
Inverse of ImplementsDance, from DanceImplementation to TypeDescriptor.
Pins a DanceImplementation to exactly one DanceType interface it satisfies.
Inverse of ForDance, from DanceType to DanceImplementation.
Links a DanceType to the holon type used as its request contract.
Inverse of RequestType, from HolonType to DanceType.
Links a DanceType to the DanceResponseType used to structure its response.
Inverse of Response, from DanceResponseType to DanceType.
Links a DanceResponseType to the concrete holon type that will serve as the structured response body.
Inverse of ResponseBody, from HolonType to DanceResponseType.
Links a DanceInvocation to the holon whose effective affordances resolve the invocation's DanceName.
Inverse of AffordingHolon, from HolonType to DanceInvocation.
Links a DanceInvocation holon to the concrete request holon supplied for that invocation.
Inverse of Request, from HolonType to DanceInvocation.
Links a DanceResponseType to zero or more DanceDiagnostic holons that carry non-fatal notes.
Inverse of Diagnostics, from DanceDiagnostic to DanceResponseType.
Unique string identifier for a DanceType descriptor, used in dispatch tables.
Human-readable explanation of what the dance does or when it should be invoked.

Declarative execution context required by a DanceType, independent of ingress, routing, and implementation placement. Concrete DanceTypes default to SpaceAuthoritative at authoring time; ContainerLocal and HostAuthoritative must be explicit.
Ingress context for a DanceInvocation, recorded as an InvocationSource enum value.
Severity classification for a DanceDiagnostic holon.
Stable machine-readable code for a DanceDiagnostic holon.
Human-readable message for a DanceDiagnostic holon.
Machine-readable status code indicating the result of the dance.
Execution engine for the implementation (e.g., WasmWasi, Process, RustDylib, Builtin).
Content-address or locator of the executable module (e.g., hash/URL/capability address).
Function/export name to invoke inside the module.
Identifier of the stable smart contract ABI expected by the module/entrypoint.
Semantic version or content hash pin of the implementation.
Compatibility range or constraints (e.g., ABI or schema versions).
Human-readable summary of a dance outcome.
Unique name of a DanceImplementation instance.
Enum value type that records how a DanceInvocation entered the runtime.
Invocation entered the runtime through a client command ingress path.
Invocation entered the runtime through a trust-channel ingress path.
Invocation originated from trusted internal runtime code.
Execution context required by a DanceType contract.
Requires execution in the local container that hosts the current runtime.
Requires the native host to provide the authoritative implementation.
Requires the MAP space to provide the authoritative implementation.
Enum value type for the severity of a DanceDiagnostic holon.
Informational non-fatal diagnostic note.
Warning-level non-fatal diagnostic note.
Deprecated old-world enum value type for dance status codes. New-world success and failure are expressed by the outer Result contract.
200 — Request succeeded.
202 — Request accepted but not yet processed.
400 — The request was malformed or invalid.
401 — The requester is not authenticated.
403 — The requester lacks permission.
404 — The target resource was not found.
409 — Conflict with the current state of the resource.
422 — Semantic validation failed.
500 — Unexpected internal error.
501 — Functionality required to fulfill the request is not supported.
503 — The server is currently unable to handle the request (overload/maintenance).
Enum value type for execution engines used by DanceImplementations.
Execute a WASM module under WASI (preferred).
Spawn a separate OS process with protocol pipes.
Dynamically load a Rust dylib via FFI (platform-coupled).
Call a registered host builtin function.
Concrete projection holon type containing exactly one holon_id property.
Concrete commit response-body holon type retained under its existing key during parallel buildout. Instances are projection-shaped response holons.
Transient projection of a Commit validation finding whose subject has no staged carrier.
Projected ViolationKind field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected RuleIdentity field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected RuleCode field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected ConstraintIdentity field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected ConstraintTypeIdentity field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected Severity field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected SubjectKind field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected HolonIdentity field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected MemberName field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected TargetIdentity field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected Message field of a Commit validation finding.
Projected DescriptorIdentity field of a Commit validation finding.
Number of live staged candidates presented to validation on this commit attempt; excludes abandoned and already committed entries.
Number of semantic validation findings in the report that produced this response; 0 when accepted.
Enum value type for commit request outcomes (Complete, Incomplete, Rejected).
Validation accepted and all eligible node and relationship persistence completed.
Operational persistence failed; some writes may have completed and staged entries remain available for retry.
Semantic assessment completed and persistence was refused; nothing was written and the transaction remains open.
Overall status of the commit request (Complete, Incomplete, or Rejected).
Findings without a staged candidate carrier returned by Commit.
Inverse link from a finding to its Commit response.
Declared relationship from a CommitResponse to each holon successfully saved by this commit.
Inverse of SavedHolons. Links a holon to a CommitResponse that successfully saved it.
Declared relationship from a rejected CommitResponse to each assessed staged candidate with semantic validation findings.
Inverse of RejectedHolons. Links a finding-bearing staged candidate to the CommitResponse that rejected persistence.
Retains the original Commit response for a completed loader invocation.
Identifies the load outcome retaining this Commit response.

Transient inspection view of an operational error, validation finding, or parser issue. Preserves the supplied diagnostic fields and links available original evidence and affected subjects within the owning loader context; it is never staged or committed as imported content.
Input provenance associated with an exact staged validation subject for one retained load.
Retains input provenance for staged validation subjects in one load.
Identifies the load retaining this source provenance.
Identifies the exact staged subject produced from this input source.
Exposes retained input provenance for a staged validation subject.

Identifies whether a diagnostic arose from an operational error, a staged validation finding, an unattached validation finding, a parser issue, a preparation failure, or an invocation failure. Describes its origin rather than its severity or commit outcome.

Original parser classification: IoFailure, JsonDecodingFailure, StructuralValidationFailure, or HolonConstructionFailure. Distinguishes reading input, decoding JSON, checking loader structure, and constructing the transient load graph; absent for non-parser diagnostics.
One-based line number in the original UTF-8 source, preserved exactly from the parser location. Absent when the parser supplies no location; not a line in reformatted or reconstructed JSON.

UTF-8 byte column within SourceLine, preserved exactly from the parser. Normally one-based, with zero permitted at early end-of-input; not a Unicode character count or an absolute file byte offset. Absent when the parser supplies no location.

Links a diagnostic to the actual holon affected by the reported condition, using the supplied bound reference in the loader context. Absent when no affected subject is available; never inferred from a source key, filename, or error-carrier identity.
Inverse of DiagnosticSubject: diagnostics that explicitly identify this holon as affected by a reported condition. Does not include diagnostics merely using this holon as their evidence carrier.

Links a diagnostic to its original operational-error carrier, unattached finding carrier, or staged holon retaining validation findings. Preserves access to authoritative evidence; the evidence carrier need not be the affected subject. Absent when no original holon carrier exists.

Inverse of DiagnosticEvidence: diagnostic inspection views supported by evidence retained on this holon. This relationship records evidentiary provenance and does not assert that the carrier is itself affected.

Diagnostic inspection holons associated with an actual load response, covering operational errors, staged validation findings, and unattached validation findings. Complements the original error and validation relationships without replacing their authoritative evidence.

Inverse of HasDiagnostic: actual load responses that include this diagnostic inspection holon. Distinguishes response-associated diagnostics from parser diagnostics belonging to a preparation-failure report.

One value in a structured source-error tree. Value kind distinguishes objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and null; member names preserve object fields or array positions. Child values remain individually navigable, including empty containers and null values.

Original value kind in structured diagnostic evidence: object, array, string, number, boolean, or null. Distinguishes empty containers, absent scalar content, and literal null without relying on a display string.

Exact scalar content of a structured evidence value. Strings retain their original text; numbers and booleans use their canonical text with EvidenceValueKind preserving the scalar type. Absent for objects, arrays, and null; an empty string remains an explicit value.

Structured underlying error supplied by the parser, distinct from its contextual diagnostic Message. Preserves the original error variant and every nested field as navigable evidence values; absent when no underlying error was supplied.
Diagnostics whose underlying source error is represented by this evidence tree root.

Immediate members of an object or array in structured diagnostic evidence. Each child preserves its original object field name or zero-based array index in MemberName; array order is reconstructed from those indices, independent of relationship enumeration order.
Container evidence values that directly contain this value as an object field or array element.

Retained transient submission attempt, created before parsing. Owns exact source snapshots and links its prepared load set, diagnostics, and actual response when available; it is never staged or committed.
Exact input sources retained for one submission attempt, inspectable through ordinary collection navigation.
Filename and exact original contents submitted for preparation; retained transiently without rereading the native file.
Observed submission phase: Preparing, Prepared, Invoking, PreparationFailed, InvocationFailed, or Responded. InvocationFailed does not assert that no persistence occurred.
Exact retained source contents submitted for preparation, without reformatting or rereading the source file.
Retained exact source snapshots for this submission attempt.
Inverse of SubmittedSources; retained transient presentation links are authored on their declared source.
Sources supplied by the user for this submission attempt.
Inverse of Sources; retained transient presentation links are authored on their declared source.
Actual prepared execution payload, present only after preparation succeeds.
Inverse of PreparedLoadSet; retained transient presentation links are authored on their declared source.
Actual returned load response; absent when invocation returned no usable response.
Inverse of LoadResponse; retained transient presentation links are authored on their declared source.
Retained submission attempt that produced this response.
Inverse of LoadRequest; retained transient presentation links are authored on their declared source.
Typed preparation or invocation failure evidence retained in the loader context.
Inverse of Diagnostics; retained transient presentation links are authored on their declared source.
Retained submission attempt completed within the admitted runtime invocation.
Inverse of LoadRequest; retained transient presentation links are authored on their declared source.
